summary: Possible Ventures is a Munich-registered investor that backs mission-driven teams using frontier technology on humanity-scale problems. Its portfolio pages feature The Exploration Company (reusable orbital vehicles), Orbem (AI imaging for food and agriculture), Reverion (fuel cells) and Marvel Fusion, and the network page lists a large member community. The site does not state a stage, check size, sector list or investment geography, and the imprint gives only a care-of registered address, so those points need direct confirmation.

investmentEvidence.fact: Featured on the homepage as a portfolio company building a modular reusable orbital vehicle. Round and date are not stated.
Featured on the homepage as a portfolio company working on fusion energy. Round and date are not stated.
